aries.profile: Direct, energetic and quick to begin. Aries usually prefers momentum, honest expression and taking the first step rather than waiting.
aries.strength: Initiative, courage and willingness to act.
aries.challenge: Impatience, reacting too quickly or pushing before enough reflection.

taurus.profile: Steady, practical and security-minded. Taurus usually values stability, comfort, patience and things that can prove their worth over time.

gemini.profile: Curious, flexible and mentally active. Gemini usually enjoys learning, comparing ideas and keeping conversation or information moving.

cancer.profile: Protective, instinctive and emotionally aware. Cancer usually values belonging, care, familiarity and emotional safety.

leo.profile: Expressive, warm and creative. Leo usually values heartfelt self-expression, dignity and the freedom to be visibly itself.
leo.challenge: Pride or needing too much recognition.

virgo.profile: Careful, practical and detail-aware. Virgo usually notices what can be improved and often expresses care through useful attention.

libra.profile: Balanced, relational and diplomatic. Libra usually values proportion, cooperation and understanding how different viewpoints can meet.

scorpio.profile: Intense, perceptive and private. Scorpio usually prefers depth over surface, sincerity over pretense and emotional truth over vagueness.
scorpio.strength: Focus, emotional depth and strategic awareness.
scorpio.challenge: Suspicion, fixation or holding too tightly.

sagittarius.profile: Open, future-facing and meaning-seeking. Sagittarius usually values movement, possibility, perspective and a sense that life can expand.

capricorn.profile: Structured, pragmatic and long-term oriented. Capricorn usually focuses on responsibility, durable progress and what can actually be built.

aquarius.profile: Independent, future-minded and idea-driven. Aquarius usually values originality, perspective and doing things differently from habit.

pisces.profile: Receptive, imaginative and sensitive. Pisces usually responds through mood, intuition, empathy and subtle impressions rather than hard edges.
